scope: Fixed thirteen-variant evidence coverage rubric, data collection only.
primary_definition: Only independently inspected wartime/period source evidence, including scans reproduced by websites, with deductions for nonmatching specimens, untested operating points or design rather than measured figures. Published original source without measured numeric applicable data receives only limited qualitative coverage.
augmented_definition: Primary plus explicitly attributed historical-secondary findings, same-variant but different-specimen comparisons and transparent physical derivations confined to their stated assumptions. Modern game flight models are cross-checks, NOT historical flight-test measurements. Categories remain capped; no inference can manufacture source-matched measured CAS or sustained-turn data.
score_policy: Expert-judgment evidence-coverage checklist, 0..100 points. Incremental scores are conservative; recovering a citation or identifying a report without its numbers does not itself close the missing-performance category. Reprint is same original source, not another independent measurement. Two lanes are not probabilities and may remain below target. Achieving 80 is an ambition, NOT a release gate override.
